# netbox_export_template (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox export template (`/api/extras/export-templates/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_export_template" "sites_csv" {
  name = "sites-csv"
}

output "sites_csv_mime_type" {
  value = data.netbox_export_template.sites_csv.mime_type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/extras/export-templates/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `as_attachment` (Boolean) Download file as attachment. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `data_file_id` (Number) Data File. References `netbox_data_file`.
- `data_path` (String) Path to remote file (relative to data source root).
- `data_source_id` (Number) ID of the Data Source (`netbox_data_source`).
- `data_synced` (String) Data Synced.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `environment_params` (String) Any <a href="https://jinja.palletsprojects.com/en/stable/api/#jinja2.Environment">additional parameters</a> to pass when constructing the Jinja environment.
- `file_extension` (String) Extension to append to the rendered filename. Defaults to an empty string.
- `file_name` (String) Filename to give to the rendered export file. Defaults to an empty string.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `mime_type` (String) Defaults to <code>text/plain; charset=utf-8</code>. Defaults to an empty string.
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object Types.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `template_code` (String) Jinja template code.
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
